   # File-> New-> Other -> Empty EMF Project
   # Open UNICASE perspective and right click on project you want to generate Ecore model from an select -Generate Ecore-
   # Select model-Folder of your EMF Project and give name for your .ecore File
   # Change to Java perspective and refresh your EMF Project and you see your _italic_myfile.ecore File
   # In Ecore Editor right click on your package and select -Load Ressource- and then click on Browse Workspace and select org.unicase.model/model/model.ecore 
   # Set in Properties (double click on each Class) for all classes ESuperTypes to UnicaseModelElement
   # Set Name to your_package_name, NS Prefix to org.unicase.model.your_package_name  and NS URI http://org.unicase.model.your_package_name (spaces in names are not allowed)
   # Right click on your package and select Validate from the context menu

   # Change to Java prespective
   # File-> New-> Other -> EMF Generator Model and set name for example your_ecore_model_name.genmodel -> Next
   # Ecore Model (Select Model Importer) -> Next (Ecore Import) -> Browse workspace and select your ecore file -> Next
   # Select as root package only your own package, select all packages in Referenced generator model too.
   # Finish

   # Now open the gemodel (double click)
   # Double click on root element and set in the properties All-> Base Package to org.unicase.model and click to save
   # Double click on package element and set in the properties these fields:
 - All -> Compilance Level - 5.0
          Copyright Fields - true
          Copyright Text - hier you should paste your  copyright
- Edit
